content: Paulus po vatano wanave Yesus aije mapan no Makedonia muno Yunani

Wayaowi unepatare umaso mewen to, umba Paulus po vatano wanave Yesus aije mawainde indamu po ananyao inta raugaje mai indamu mansanuga mbambunin. Po manyaowa jewen, umba pare, “Amisye tuna wansautan tenambe,” umba puje poroto no propinsi Makedonia.
Umba panya no Makedonia siso puje ama varodore raita, apa ananyao manui po raugaje irati vatano wanave Yesus aije mansai indamu manuga mbambunin. Panyanare so pui ti nanto no propinsi Yunani.

Embae mandeij Paulus no no naije. Pare tavondi nyomano ngkayune rai to no munijo Siria, weramu daniv vatano Yahudi inta wanyinyaube ware wo aubaisy arono seo nyomane rai. Maisyare omai ti, po unanui kaijinta rapatimu pare, “Indati syakare syanya unanuijo Makedonia raito.”

Vatano nanawirati ware utavondi aije awa tame mi som: Sopater opamo vatano Berea apa aja pirati Pirus; muno Aristarkus muno Sekundus vatano Tesalonika nanaije; muno Gayus vatano Derbe pije; muno Timotius; muno Tikikus muno Tropimus vatano Asia nanaije.
Weti vatane umaso wuisy wanawadi no munijo Troas ware wo Paulus anyut.

Weramu risyirati Lukas ritavondi Paulus ai. Ono Paska mewen to, arono vatano Yahudi wo rotijo ragije mewen daije raisy. One umaso mewen, umba ririnsea nyomano ngkayune rai no munijo Pilipi. Masyote radani umba ririnande vatano uma wo ririnsanyute mansai no Troas, umba reana no Troas raija masyote kaururum.
Paulus po arikainyo kamuram kakai aijaseo kovakato

Minggugo namije ama masyoto manasyine rai, arakovo reamanave Yesus aije reamanunugambe indamu reamisyi tenambe. Paulus opamo po ananyao raura reansai wusyimbe. Payao ava namane yasyin, weye simanamo pare panya akato.
Tanoano reantantuna rai ntami no yavare ama eteto mandeije rai. Tanoane umaso mamo yawainyo raindi manui indamu mbaro rai.

Arikainyo kamurame inta apa tame mirati Eutikus tuna no tanoane umaso ama unsanda mamaune inta rai. Paulus payao nggwaravainy ti arikainye umaso amije maomon dave. Arono niki kobe, naije temasyo no waraya. Temaje raije so nggwaravain dave ti arono vatane wo aijaseoamo kakai to.
Paulus pasyo no mine waraya, umba paje po akepan seo. Umba po raura pare, “Vemo wasanimaumbe inya! Weye arikainye sopamo kovakatoa!”

Umba Paulus pakaseo no tanoano warae akato. Muno wepe apa arakovo wanave Yesus aije nawe wo rotije raporadi umba wisyi tenambe. Wisyisya jewen, umba payao akato ava awatan ngko dave akane ntipu. Umba Paulus seo panya ti poroto kobe.
Muno vatane wo arikainyo kamurame umawe augave uta no apa yavar. Kovakato to ti vatane manayanambe rave.
Paulus po ayao inta raura irati akarijo wo anugano Amisye maugave mai no Epesus

Arono naije reamare reanta no munijo Asos. Paulus panya yawa obo rai, yara apa arakove ream reansea nyomano ngkayune rai. Paulus pare, “Arono ride no Asos, indati riseo nyomane rai wasatavon.” Maisyare omaisy, reamuisy nyomane rai umba reanta no Asos.
Arono Paulus nande reansai no naije, seo nyomane rai reansatavon. Umba reanta no munijo Metilene.

Siman akato reama nyomane mo reansaugav akato umba reande no munije inta rai mararaijo nupatimugo Kios rai. Umba siman akato reande no nupatimugo Samos rai. Umba siman akato reansisa no munijo Miletus rai.

Miletus umaso mamo mararai nande Epesus rai, weramu Paulus po rapatimu pare siso no Epesus raije ramu, weye ponae no masyote nggwaravain no Asia raiji. Yara beker pavave to no Yerusalem indamu tavondi Ono Pentakosta weye one ama matam akari mararai to.
Arono Paulus no no Miletus, po apa ayaowe ranutu irati akarijo wo anugano Amisye maugave mai no Epesus indamu ude ai no Miletus.
Ude ai, umba po raura mansai pare, “Wapo rinaeno sya ana syo rave rai tenambe arono manasyin risiso propinsi Asia so rai nde ava unumeso.

Syanapatambe Amisye ai, inanuga mamo mpaaje vayave yara rinararimbe ramu. Inaemembe wasai ravea inami ngkaruge ntende. Weramu vatano Yahudi nanawamo wanyinyaube ware wo kakaije raugaje rinai, weti mangkeo rinai rave.
Syo ananyao ngkov irati wasai raugaje wasai tenambe to, yara syo ananyao inta rangkokaibe wasaije ramu. Syo ayao Yesus ravovo yavare raita muno vatano wanuije mansamun.
Syo raura kakavimbe vatano Yahudi mansai to muno vatano Yunani mai tavon indamu usakinavo ayao kakaije rai muno wanave Amisy Yesus ai.
Soamo Anawayo Vambunine mo inatutir indamu syoroto no Yerusalem. Weramu ana inta mare nande rinai no naijeamo syo raen kobe jewen.
Syo raen bayave munije kotare raita, Anawayo Vambunine mo rarorono rinai mare indati siurije nande rinai muno rimakova.

Weti siurije nande kai, weye inanasine somamo kopa vayave ma. Yara mbe mobe mamo syo anakero Amisy Yesus po raugaje rinaije mamo syo raijar ava mewen to. Weti syo anakere so raijar matuve indamu syo Amisye apa Ayao Kove ravov, wemirati mo Apa kove raugavo vatane mansai.
Sya arakove, arono rino no wapa yasyine raijoe, syo masyoto Amisye de be akarive Apa kawasae mai no mine vone so raura wasai. Weramu soamo syo raen indati wapo inaen akatoe ramu.

Weti masyoto unumeso syo raura kakavimbe wasai: Amisye apa bekere mamo syo inta rangkokaibe wasaije ramu, yara syo raura kakavimbe wasai tenambe to. Weti are nawirati wonayo wanavei wenawamo taune wo awa mangkeye ranawan, yara risyamo kakavimbe.

Weapamo Anawayo Vambunine mo wasatayao indamu wabe akarive anugano Amisye mai. Weti syare wapo Amisye apa anugane umaso maeranande kobe muno taune wasanuga mamo wapo raeranande tavon. Wapo maeranande maisyare vatane po apa domba maeranande wemaisy, weye Amisy po taune apa Kavo aunanto inda kakai wirati Po apa anugane maugavo amarom.
Weramu wasyisyaube! Weye syo raen arono indati syo wasapaya ti syorotoa, umba vatano mamun ware ude usisa irati wasai. Wenanawamo maisyare makeo usivuiny unande wo domba maubaisye wemaisy.
Muno vatano kaijo nanawirati usambayambe no wapa yasyine raije inta indati usea usayai umba wo ayao angkari rave wasaponae. Ubeker ware wo vatano wanave Yesus aije maugaveta utavondi mai.
Maisyare omai ti, syare wasyisyaube! Wasaemen syo wasanyaowa tume mandei to. Namane rinit syo wasanyao tutir, inaemeno wasai yava inami ngkaruge ntende.

Indati syo wasamune raen akatoe ramu, weti soamo syo wasaunanta Amisye taune nui indamu Po wasaeranande. Muno syare wasaemen irati ayao mo Apa kove raura rai. Weye Amisye wepi bambunin po wasaijasea wabambunin muno Po kove raugaje wasai, omamo kovo Po ratayao Apa kawasae mansai tenambe.
Risyamo inanuga ntento vatane awa ananuge inta raije ramu, awa perakije ndako, awa emasije ndako, awa ansuno ngko dave inta rai vayave jewen.
Wapo inaen to syo anakere raijar inaneme so rai indamu syo anaisye ramavun indamu risye sya arakovo utavondi rinaije nawe reandaisy.

Syo raveare so indamu ibe unanuive wasai, syare koveamo wamo anakere raijaro panyoambe indamu wamo vatano manasine mayondi mansaeranande. Weye wansaemen irati Amisy Yesus apa ayao so rai no taiso: ‘Weapamo wasanayanambe arono vatane wo wapa ana wabekedaije raunande wasai, weramu Amisye anayanambe wasai arono wapo vatano kaijinta awa ana ubekedaije raunanto mai.’ ”
Arono Paulus payaoware soa mewen, umba wepe vatano una tenambe no nanawije wo vukane ranteter usambayambe.
Wo Paulus aneme raijar umba mansamune ranyinyaibe ai. Muno woyovo ai rave,
weye po raura to pare indati wo amune raen akatoe ramu. Umba wo auga ti uta no mayane vone rai indamu Paulus seo nyomane rai.
